LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_RareXeno: the genes of the {0} kind, which the Works can read
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_DonorGone: The one they asked for is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Sample: {0} keeps still where they are, and the sample-buyer walks over and draws a little blood from the arm, below anything that would weaken them, gone in a few hours. The Works pay at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_SampleBrief: A small blood draw for the Works
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Drawn: {BUYER} has drawn a little blood from {PAWN}'s arm for the Helix Works, and paid {COUNT} silver for it.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_TakerGone: The one the gene was for is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_GeneTaken: That gene would no longer take.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Gene: {0} keeps still while the sequencer works on them two hours, and carries the Works' gene {1} from then, as a xenogene; no other xenogerm until it has settled.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_GeneWritten: {SEQ} has written the Works' gene {GENE} into {PAWN}. It will be a while before anything else can be written in.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Batch: {0} sees to the {1} of the Works' sick vat-grown where they stand, a medicine from the stores for each.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_HurtMechs: {0} of them, with {1} wounds between them
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_NothingHurt: The colony's mechs no longer need mending.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Repair: The mech-tender goes from mech to mech and mends each where it stands, {0} of them, each kept still at its turn.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Mended: {PAWN} of the Lattice has mended the colony's mechs and is going home.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_MechGone: The lost mech is no longer here.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_NoKeeper: The colony has no mechanitor with the bandwidth to take it on.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Return: A link-warden of the Lattice walks in to the {0}, relinks it and walks it home.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Keep: The {0} is the colony's, with {1} to oversee it.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_MechHome: The {0} wanders off the map the way it came.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Relinked: {PAWN} of the Lattice has relinked the {MECH}, and the two of them are walking home together.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Kept: The {MECH} is the colony's now, and {PAWN} oversees it. {FACTION} will not forgive it soon.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_PartsGone: The subcores and chips are no longer in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_NoTurretSite: There is no clear ground by the gate for it.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Turret: The engineer raises a {0} by the gate, the colony's from then on; it wants the colony's power to fire.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_TurretRaised: {PAWN} of the Lattice has raised a turret by the gate. Connect it to the colony's power and it will watch the road.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Listen: The listeners sit in a ring in the colony's middle for a few hours, and then the colony feels it.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_ListenFelt: The {0} others at home feel a calm (+4) or an unease (-3) afterwards, the psychically sensitive the most, the psychically deaf nothing.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_ListenFeltBrief: A calm for some, an unease for others
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Heard: The listeners of {FACTION} have heard the colony. A calm came over {CALM}; an unease over {UNEASY}.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_ArtGone: The art they asked for is no longer packed in the stores.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_OrdinarySays: So that is what this is for.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Stay_Coming: {0} of the Choir is on the road to the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Stay_Staying: {0} of the Choir is staying at the colony: {1} afternoons beside its people at work so far.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Supply: {0} remember the components and food as supply: given parts, the vault holds its age instead of falling back.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_SupplyGift: {0} remember the components and food as a friend's supply, and more of it: given parts, the vault holds its age instead of falling back.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_BenchGone: The bench is no longer there.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Teach: {0} teaches the vault's technician at the {1} for a few hours; the vault can make it again, and remembers who taught it.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_CraftLearned: {PAWN} of {FACTION} has learned the work of the {CRAFT} again, and is taking it home to the vault.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_Impact_Sky: {0} stands in the open by the gate a while, looking up.
LanguageData.CC_PeoplesG_SawTheSky: {PAWN_nameDef} has stood under the open sky a long while, and keeps looking up.
